WITH employee_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    ReportsTo,
    COUNT(*) as employee_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(employee_count) as total_employees,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM employee_groups
)
SELECT 
  eg.ReportsTo,
  eg.employee_count,
  eg.employee_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees as share,
  eg.employee_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees - 1.0 / t.num_groups as difference
FROM employee_groups eg
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
